baseline_recovery_reproduction_source:
"""Reproduce committed recovery alias defects in fresh isolated engine fixtures."""
import ast
from pathlib import Path
import subprocess
import sys
ROOT=Path(__file__).resolve().parents[2]
sys.path.insert(0,str(ROOT))
from pokemon.battle.tests.test_reactive_item_consumption import BERRIES, name, test_recovery_then_theft_cannot_duplicate_the_consumed_copy
from pokemon.dex.functions import abilities_funcs
from pokemon.dex.functions.moves import damage_moves
for path, module, class_name, method in (
    ("pokemon/dex/functions/abilities_funcs.py", abilities_funcs, "Harvest", "onResidual"),
    ("pokemon/dex/functions/moves/damage_moves.py", damage_moves, "Recycle", "onHit"),
):
    source=subprocess.check_output(["git","show","d1cbe5175e1a30a9c25c055aec84e1b5a2afe4b0:"+path],cwd=ROOT).decode("utf-8")
    node=next(n for n in ast.parse(source).body if isinstance(n,ast.ClassDef) and n.name==class_name)
    namespace=dict(vars(module))
    if class_name=="Harvest": namespace["random"]=lambda: 0.0
    exec(compile(ast.Module(body=[node],type_ignores=[]),path,"exec"),namespace)
    setattr(getattr(module,class_name),method,getattr(namespace[class_name],method))
failed=0
for recovery in ("recycle","harvest"):
    for item in BERRIES:
        try:
            test_recovery_then_theft_cannot_duplicate_the_consumed_copy(item,recovery)
        except AssertionError as error:
            trace=error.__traceback__
            while trace.tb_next:
                trace=trace.tb_next
            holder,foe=trace.tb_frame.f_locals['holder'],trace.tb_frame.f_locals['foe']
            assert name(holder.item)==name(foe.item)==item, 'Expected the actual duplicated copy'
            failed+=1
            print("Committed recovery alias defect reproduced:",recovery,item)
assert failed==8,failed
print("8 fresh baseline recovery regressions reproduced; no game database used")
